name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
September 23, 2014
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
INVOCATION - Vicar Paul Martin, Faith Lutheran Church
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation declaring October to be "Rideshare Month," and Wednesday, October 8, 2014, "Walk and Bike to School Day" in the City of Vista.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD/SA)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending July 31, 2014 (CC)
C4.
Alta Vista Gardens Fall Fun Festival Special Event Signs (CC)
C5.
Appointments of Youth Commissioners (CC)
C6.
Unclaimed Trust Deposits (CC)
C7.
2013-2014 Community Development Block Grant Consolidated (CDBG) Annual Performance & Evaluation Report (CC)
C8.
Red Zone at Bus Stop Located at 645 S. Melrose Drive (CC)
C9.
Speed Humps on Private Property (CC)
1.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2014-, entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Section 16.57.080 of the Vista Development Code Relating to Speed Bumps and Speed Humps on Private Property."
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , repealing City Council Policy 600-09, Speed Humps on Private Streets.
C10.
No Stopping and Commercial Loading Zones on Olive Avenue (CC)
C11.
Recognized Obligation Payment Schedule (ROPS 14-15B) (CC/CDC/SA)
1.
Adopt the following Successor Agency Resolutions:
a.
Resolution No. 2014- , approving ROPS 14-15B; and
b.
Resolution No. 2014- , approving the Administrative Budget.
2.
Adopt the following resolutions approving an agreement regarding expenditure of pre-2011 housing bond proceeds:
a.
Successor Agency Resolution No. 2014- ; and
b.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2014- .
3.
Adopt the following resolutions approving an agreement regarding expenditure of 2011 tax-exempt bond proceeds:
a.
Successor Agency Resolution No. 2014- ; and
b.
City Council Resolution No. 2014- .
C12.
Sale of Successor Agency, Community Development Commission and City Properties (CC/CDC/SA)
1.
Successor Agency Resolution No. 2014- , 1315 N. Santa Fe Avenue.
2.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2014- , 420 Lado de Loma Drive.
3.
City Council Resolution No. 2014- , 1335 N. Santa Fe Avenue.
DISCUSSION
PUBLIC HEARING
PH1.
Appeal of Special Use Permit (SUP) for 7-Eleven at 902 S. Santa Fe Avenue (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to consider an appeal of Planning Case No. 8-267, a request for an SUP for the off-site sale of beer and wine at 902 S. Santa Fe Avenue.
2.
Adopt either of the following City Council Resolutions:
a.
Resolution No. 2014- , granting an SUP for the off-site sale of beer and wine; or
b.
Resolution No. 2014- , denying an SUP for the off-site sale of beer and wine.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
